generations.name: First generation (V295)
generations.notes: Launch on EVA2, 400 V. All North American trims (350+, 350 4MATIC, 500 4MATIC, AMG EQE) on a 90.6 kWh usable pack, about 170 kW DC. AMG EQE is a variant of this model. Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz_EQE ; https://www.greencarreports.com/news/1144846_2025-mercedes-benz-eqe-price

generations.name: 2025 update (96 kWh pack)
generations.notes: EQE 350+ and EQE 500 4MATIC (2026: EQE 320+) move to a 96 kWh usable pack; 350 4MATIC / 320 4MATIC and the AMG keep 90.5-90.6 kWh. DC stays about 170 kW. MY2026 renames the 350 trims "320". Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.greencarreports.com/news/1144846_2025-mercedes-benz-eqe-price ; https://www.kbb.com/mercedes-benz/eqe/ ; https://www.mbusa.com/en/vehicles/model/eqe/sedan/eqe320v4
